title: Korea Was Free for 5 Minutes...Then Came the Line #shorts
description:
In August 1945, Korea was finally free after 35 years of Japanese rule, but only for a moment. Two young American officers drew a line on a map at the 38th parallel, splitting the country between the Soviets and the Americans. Within five years, that "temporary" line became a war that never truly ended.

Watch the full story: Why Are There Two Koreas? | The History of Korea, on CountryCorns.
